name: Nemotron 3 Ultra
description: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra is a flagship open-weight frontier LLM family engineered for agentic AI workloads, long-context understanding, complex reasoning, and tool calling. The family includes Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B (a hybrid Transformer-Mamba LatentMoE model with 1M context) and Llama-3.1-Nemotron-Ultra-253B-v1.
keyFeatures: Hybrid LatentMoE & Mamba Architecture: Combines Mamba-2 state space model layers with Latent MoE (550B total / 55B active parameters)
Dual-Mode System: Toggles between low-latency chat mode and extended Chain-of-Thought reasoning mode
Ultra-Long Context Window: Supports up to 1,000,000 (1M) tokens context window for long-horizon agent state tracking
NVFP4 Native Optimization: Native NVFP4 4-bit floating-point quantization for single-node (8xH100/B200) high-throughput deployment
Agentic Post-Training & Tool Integration: Multi-environment RL post-training for function calling (BFCL), SWE-bench coding, and RAG
curatorNotes: Verified technical report arXiv:2512.20856 and open-weight model releases from NVIDIA.
